messages:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding run for granite-13b failed the smoke evals. Looks like a token-span shift after HF->Redwood config conversion, not an obvious model quality regression. Posting diffs I found.
jordan: Can you paste the converted config + the original? Quick grep for rope_scaling/sliding_window/num_kv_heads/max_position_embeddings would help.
maya: Sure — HF config (excerpt):
```json
{
  \"hidden_size\": 4096,
  \"num_attention_heads\": 32,
  \"num_key_value_heads\": 16,
  \"max_position_embeddings\": 16384,
  \"rope_scaling\": {\"type\": \"linear\", \"factor\": 1.0},
  \"sliding_window\": false
}
```
Converted Redwood config (what converter produced):
```json
{
  \"hidden_size\": 4096,
  \"num_attention_heads\": 32,
  \"num_key_value_heads\": 32,        // suspicious: converter copied heads from attention
  \"max_position_embeddings\": 2048, // truncated during conversion
  \"rope_scaling\": null,            // dropped
  \"sliding_window\": true          // flipped default
}
```

oliver: Oof. That explains token offsets. If num_kv_heads was doubled, KV cache layout will differ and decoder will attend wrong memory indexes -> token span misalignment. Also max_pos shrink means the tokenizer/prompt chunker likely remapped special tokens near the end.
maya: Example of the failure — prompt+expected vs actual token alignment (shortened):
```
Prompt: \"Summarize: The user's dataset contains PII...\"
Expected: \"Summary: The dataset contains...\"
Actual:   \"Summary: The user's dataset contains\" + \"<?padding?>\"  <-- weird token break
```
Indices from model logits show a consistent +1 shift when generating after preserved context.
lee: We saw amplification when running int8 quantized weights. Quantization exposes shape mismatches more strongly; the KV reshape code path assumes num_kv_heads == num_attn_heads or explicit mapping. If converter sets num_key_value_heads incorrectly the stride into the packed tensor is wrong, producing off-by-chunk reads.
jordan: Quick triage steps: 1) set num_key_value_heads back to 16 (manual patch) 2) restore max_position_embeddings to 16384 in converted config 3) re-enable rope_scaling mapping from HF value 4) set sliding_window false and rerun smoke evals
maya: I ran step 1+2 locally — restores alignment on the short regression set. Patch command I used: `jq '.num_key_value_heads=16 | .max_position_embeddings=16384 | .rope_scaling={"type":"linear","factor":1.0} | .sliding_window=false' conv.json > conv.fixed.json`
oliver: For the tokenizer: HF model used custom pad token `<|pad|>` and chat template inserted trailing special token which we lost. Converter stripped special tokens because of tokenizers.json mismatch. That explains trailing odd tokens. We need to port `added_tokens.json` and `special_tokens_map.json` into Redwood tokenizer registry.
lee: Action items: oliver will open a PR to the converter to 1) validate and copy `num_key_value_heads` separately (don’t derive from attn heads), 2) preserve `rope_scaling` objects (or warn), 3) keep `max_position_embeddings` unless user explicitly truncates, 4) carry over special token maps.
oliver: Yep, I'll draft the PR. Also adding a converter unit test: roundtrip HF config -> Redwood -> validate that `num_key_value_heads` and `rope_scaling` are equal or explicit deltas are flagged.
onboard-bot: config-conversion-checker: 2 warnings for granite-13b: [num_key_value_heads mismatch], [max_position_embeddings decreased]. See /onboard/2301234567.
maya: Thanks — re-running quant/INT8 evals on conv.fixed.json now. Will report regressed prompts + eval diffs in this thread. If it looks good, lee can add this to the onboarding runbook checklist.
lee: Please add a tiny smoke-case that asserts token index alignment for the first 128 tokens. :thumbsup:
jordan: Long-term: converter should also check chat_template placeholders — some templates inject special tokens at end-of-turn which the tokenizer must mark as non-splittable. Add that to PR.
maya: Agreed. For now I'll run the three quant levels and attach eval artifacts. If anyone wants to pair on the token map migration early tomorrow ping me.
oliver: I'll include a small converter CLI flag `--preserve-special-tokens` so ops can opt-in immediately.
lee: Nice. Minimal fix + test should get us out of this class of breakages.
maya: Cool — will update when INT8 run finishes. Thanks all.
